beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Relevance asks what deserves attention when creating competent work becomes inexpensive.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It separates relevance from quality, novelty, popularity, and compliance with a brief.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same artifact can matter differently as its audience, purpose, or circumstances change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book develops that argument across research, literature, film, design, and visual art.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers gain a framework for defending judgments while preserving space for unfamiliar work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A method can matter urgently to one community and remain peripheral to another.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its technical properties need not change when the surrounding decision does.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore treats relevance as an argued relationship, rather than an intrinsic score.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Evidence about craft or novelty can inform that judgment without settling it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This distinction connects its scientific examples with its discussion of culture and design.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A relevance dossier begins with the decision, affected people, values, constraints, and time horizon.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It connects specific claims to evidence, uncertainty, and possible counterarguments.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different critics may assess feasibility, novelty, user value, or cultural contribution.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their disagreement is useful information, not noise that a final score must erase.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book also warns that multiple evaluators can share the same mistakes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A system trained on earlier success can overlook work whose value is not yet recognized.
